nina_sales: Customer 'BrightCart' requested a 3-day POC. Requirements: streaming SDK demo that normalizes checkout events to strict JSON (order_id, customer_id, items[]), function/tool calling for validation, SAML SSO, EU data residency, and a reserved-capacity estimate for ~180 qps peak. Can we start Tue morning?

omar_se: OK. Need avg tokens (after client-side OCR/cleanup) and burst profile. Also confirm they want Dedicated for SLA.

nina_sales: They said ~90 tokens avg, short bursts to 200 qps. Yes, they prefer Dedicated for predictable latency.

tess_devx: For demo: use streaming + functions to enforce schema. Small Node snippet for slides:

```js
const s = client.responses.stream({model:'redwood-small-1', input:'Normalize checkout event', functions:[{name:'normalize', parameters:{type:'object',properties:{order_id:{type:'string'},items:{type:'array'}},required:['order_id']}}]});
s.on('data', evt => console.log(evt));
```

raj_security: Remind them to redact any PANs. We'll provide SOC2 summary and fill their questionnaire. If they require HSM-backed KMS, that adds lead time.

infra_bot: infra-bot: queued dedicated-poc-eu-west (project: brightcart-poc) :white_check_mark:

nina_sales: I'll request SAML metadata + sample redacted payload and propose Tue 09:00 CET. Omar, can you draft a short pricing ballpark for reserved capacity?

omar_se: Yes — will send a ballpark and include a POC credit.

tess_devx: I'll build a one-page runbook: stream ingest -> function call -> schema validation -> load test.

nina_sales: Thanks team, next steps done. :thumbsup:
